propositions: Bedrock cells us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 were measured in E1 to support native structured output with extended thinking but are blocked by family-level native_structured_output: False override

The native_output_with_thinking field is omitted from three ModelCapabilities construction sites (profile path, string-fallback path, and _intersect_capabilities for FallbackModel chains), causing override values to be silently dropped and defaulting to False

native_output_with_thinking must be plumbed through all three ModelCapabilities construction paths and intersected conservatively across FallbackModel candidates using all() to preserve the measured capability
Bedrock opus-4-7 and opus-4-8 lack measured wire-legal evidence for native structured output under thinking and must remain fail-closed to PromptedOutput despite carrying temperature override rows

Unit tests must verify both measured cells route to NativeOutput, non-measured cells route to PromptedOutput, and any omission of native_output_with_thinking from the three construction sites causes test failures
